scalars.scalar_value: Two (2+) years of Medical Assistant experience in an outpatient clinical setting.
A minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience working as a Medical Assistant.

items.item_text: Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) OR Certificate of completion of a Medical Assistant training program.
BART or BLS at time of hire with commitment to get BART within six (6) months of hire date.
Required to float, as needed, between the McGrath Outpatient Pavilion, Moores Cancer Center, and Koman Outpatient Pavilion locations.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
A minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience working as a Medical Assistant.
Two (2+) years of Medical Assistant experience in an outpatient clinical setting.
Previous experience and knowledge in direct patient care and use of EMR.
Experience working in an oncology, infusion, or women’s healthcare setting.
Experience in rooming patients and obtaining vital signs in an outpatient setting.

Under direct supervision of the clinic manager and the general supervision of the clinic providers and licensed nursing staff, performs work which requires specific knowledge and training in patient care duties within the business and professions code of the State of California and/or the regulations The Joint Commission (TJC).

These duties also include but are not limited to: scheduling of patient appointments and associated patient system screens, accurate billing, environmental care functions, equipment/supply management, and cleaning/disinfecting the environment. Requires knowledge of medical terminology, online scheduling, universal precautions, and proper use of body mechanics. The position requires initiative, the ability to prioritize demands, and the ability to work in a team environment. Other related duties as assigned.
Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of medical terminology, online scheduling, universal precautions, and proper use of body mechanics.
Demonstrated ability to take the initiative, prioritize demands, and work in a team environment.
